name: Anupa Siriwardana
headline: Building reliable backends and on‑chain systems.
about: I'm a final year Software Engineering undergraduate at the University of Colombo School of Computing. I enjoy backend work the most: designing REST APIs, modelling data, and making sure things stay consistent and secure when many operations hit the database at once.

During my six month internship at Kingslake I worked on production backend services alongside senior engineers and QA. Outside of work, building ForgeCapita pulled me into smart contracts and how financial systems can run on-chain, while my final year research looks at how object detectors can be fooled by adversarial patches, and how to catch it.
